scientific_integrity: The distribution is proved by explicit cylinder coordinates and rational integrations, checked on finite exact-rational cases. No independent audit or validation has been carried out.
scientific_limitations: Only the initial uninterrupted 2-index run following one rare digit k≥12; no mixing-rate estimate. Full-text comparison with Korolev (2025) and Augustin et al. (2001) was not possible; their general Farey polygon methods create residual priority risk.
title: Exact four-phase excursion statistics after a large BCZ index
